thread:
maya: Ok folks — quick consolidation from the Tue GPU surge postmortem. I want a short, concrete ownership plan for quota, scheduler tuning, and headroom so we don't re-run this.
trent: I can own scheduler tuning (backoff + bin-packing). Will draft tuning PR and perf test plan by EOD Thu.
lucas: Sharing perf trace: https://redwood-internal/perf/trace/3456 :point_up: scheduler ignored priorityClass for burst pods in the hot path.
ash: I'll own headroom forecasting for WA and EU. Dropping a spreadsheet & baseline in Drive now.
oncall-bot: Incident GPU_Surge_2026-03-18: postmortem created and actions logged. https://redwood-internal/incidents/2026-03-18
maya: Thanks. Let's make explicit owners + deadlines so the remediation tracker can close these. Quick table please.
trent: ```
item | owner | due | notes
-----|-------|-----|------
scheduler tuning (backoff, packing) | trent | 2026-03-25 | perf tests + canary
quota backstop (cloud request) | maya | 2026-03-28 | open quota request, add alerts
headroom forecast (WA/EU) | ash | 2026-03-24 | supply buffer targets
canary routing + fallback | lucas | 2026-03-30 | route to reserved pool on high load
weekly recurrence check | maya | 2026-04-08 | 6-week cadence monitor
```
lucas: I'll scope canary routing & fallback variant. PR by Mon 2026-03-30. Also observed pattern: recurring spikes Tuesdays ~12:00-14:00 UTC. Recommend weekly guardrail alert for queue length > 500.
maya: Good catch. Add this to the runbook: if spike detected, 1) scale to reserved pool 2) enable canary routing 3) throttle low-priority jobs. Keep it as a 3-step play.
maya: ```
# runbook excerpt
if queue_length > 500 and gpu_util > 85%:
  - immediately expand reserved pool by +20% (prefill nodes)
  - switch traffic for production-burst to canary model-variant
  - set admission-controller to DRY_RUN -> ENFORCE for low-priority jobs
```
ash: I set a calendar for owner rotation and proposed a standing 15-min weekly sync for 6 weeks to monitor remediation progress. @maya does Tues 10:00am UTC work?
maya: Tues 10:00am UTC works for me. Please map action items to Jira and link here when created.
oncall-bot: Jira tickets created: INF-8421 (scheduler-tuning), INF-8422 (headroom-forecast), INF-8423 (canary-routing). Links added to incident.
trent: Note: quota backstop requires cloud provider quota lift. I'll prepare the request today; ETA 5-7 business days. We should add a temporary fallback config until it's approved.
maya: Agreed. Final ask: everyone please add measurement criteria to their Jira ticket (SLO delta, p99 latency, queue length baseline) by EOD Fri so we can automate regressions. I'll update the remediation tracker after sync. :thumbsup:
